description: This Java source file defines the CapabilitiesDeserializer class, which implements custom JSON deserialization logic for Capabilities objects in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It parses JSON responses to extract capabilities such as API versions, theming colors, file sharing, and direct editing support.

classes.name: CapabilitiesDeserializer
classes.description: A class implementing custom JSON deserialization for Capabilities, extracting version info, theming colors, sharing capabilities, and direct editing support from JSON data.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Main method to convert JSON element into Capabilities object, parsing version info, theming colors, sharing, and editing capabilities.

methods.name: hasDirectEditingCapability
methods.description: Helper method to determine if direct editing is supported based on JSON capabilities object.
